title: The container orchestrator must not dispatch claude workers
description:
OPERATOR CONSTRAINT, 2026-09-22: 'don't use claude on the orchestrator'.

hn0 shipped the container orchestrator using the compiled-in profiles/ - executor local-subprocess, runner claude, model sonnet - and the boot REFUSES any run whose model is not on the Anthropic route, because the claude CLI speaks the Anthropic API. So today the container can only dispatch claude workers, which is the opposite of what is wanted.

Every cloud run before hn0 used GLM 5.3 through pi on Workers AI. hn0 changed the worker model without that being a decision anyone made: the profile was chosen because it was the local-subprocess one that happened to exist.

What is needed: the container dispatches workers on the gateway-backed model the factory already pays for, NOT claude. That means a runner that speaks whatever route the gateway serves - pi is the existing one - running as a local subprocess inside the container rather than in a herdr pane.

The obstacle is real and should be stated: ticfac implements only two executors, local-subprocess and herdr. profiles-herdr/ pairs pi with herdr, and there is no herdr server in the container. So the work is to run the pi runner UNDER local-subprocess, or to establish why that cannot be done.

Check internal/runconfig/kinds.go for what each runner kind requires, and internal/exec/subprocess for what the local executor can launch. The claude-specific pieces hn0 added - the Anthropic-route refusal, IS_SANDBOX for the root permission check - are claude's requirements and should move or go with it.

Until this lands, do not start a cloud epic run: the only thing the container can currently dispatch is the thing the operator has said not to use.
notes:
2026-09-22 13:41 - OPERATOR DECISION, 2026-09-22, and this is the target rather than a preference:

  Workers run GLM 5.3 or GLM 5.3 Flash. Nothing else. Via Pi, which has a Cloudflare Workers AI adapter.

So the shape is: runner = pi, model = cloudflare-workers-ai/@cf/zai-org/glm-5.3 (or the Flash variant), executor = local-subprocess, inside the orchestrator container. That is profiles-herdr/'s ROUTING with profiles/'s EXECUTOR - neither existing profile as-is.

What this repo already knows, and what has to change:

  - profiles-herdr/ already pairs pi with cloudflare-workers-ai/@cf/zai-org/glm-5.3. That is the routing to keep.
  - It pairs it with executor herdr, and there is no herdr server in the container. That is the part to replace with local-subprocess.
  - .tick/runners.toml's [roles.implement] says implementation runs 'entirely on GLM on cloudflare through pi', so this is the repo's stated intent, not a new direction. hn0 diverged from it by taking the compiled-in claude profile.

Things hn0 added that belong to claude and should go with it:
  - the boot's refusal of any non-Anthropic route ('ticfac dispatches its workers through the claude CLI, which speaks the Anthropic API'). Under pi that refusal is backwards: it would reject exactly the route we want.
  - IS_SANDBOX=1, which exists because the claude CLI refuses bypassPermissions under root. Check whether pi has an equivalent check before removing it.
  - ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL is what common.sh exports for the claude route; pi on Workers AI needs the gateway's workers-ai route instead. internal/exec/subprocess/grade.go's modelCredentialPrefixes preserves ANTHROPIC_* through the source grade - confirm the equivalent holds for whatever pi reads.

Open question to settle first, because it decides the size of this: can the pi runner be launched by the local-subprocess executor at all? internal/runconfig/kinds.go defines what each kind needs; internal/exec/subprocess is what would launch it. If pi assumes a herdr pane for its I/O, that assumption is the work.
acceptance_criteria: A cloud epic run dispatches workers on the factory's gateway model with no claude process started anywhere in the container, proven by a run whose trace shows the expected provider
